Provenance and author exposure are transparently disclosed across DESIGN-ADOPTION.json, CORE-EXECUTION-REPORTS.md, spec.md, DERIVATION.md, and fixtures/core-report-contract/README.md: the design was adopted by two independent review contexts (doctorwatson-normal-report-contract-design-semantics-20261018-a1 and doctorwatson-normal-report-contract-design-public-tooling-20261018-a1), the proposal author's source inspection is disclosed rather than treated as independent behavior proof, the three original proposal documents retain their immutable hashes and PROPOSED/UNADOPTED headers, and the custodian freeze is explicitly labeled post-adoption and specified-only rather than blinded or pre-implementation. Prior freezes (80ddf5ab..., 481f6d56..., 3911ef89...) and failure records remain untouched.

All 20 frozen payload files plus FREEZE.sha256 (7a314c14b87bb48e7ba26cc4f85096d0a5e860e8c0310d216c2437947a3ecc5b) in candidate/crates/fixtures/core-report-contract/ match independent-oracles/ byte-for-byte with identical SHA-256 digests and lengths. No product evaluator, parser, or exporter was run to generate the goldens.

Normative contract docs/CORE-EXECUTION-REPORTS.md and insertion-only OpenSpec patch normative/OPENSPEC.patch (4 hunks adding bold child paragraphs NR-01..03 under UNI-018, NR-04..05 under UNI-020, evidence boundary under UNI-021, and NR-06 under UNI-024) preserve all 69 top-level requirement headings, existing scenarios, parent roadmap exits, and requirement denominators without deletion or renumbering.

Counter specimen (counter.mori with amount=UInt("7") and empty state/balances/liabilities) and expected outputs (counter.unmetered.stdout.json 3,641 bytes; counter.cap16.stdout.json 3,745 bytes; counter.capmax.stdout.json 3,782 bytes at u128::MAX = 340282366920938463463374607431768211455) accurately specify indexes 0..4, statement expression root ExprIds 2, 5, 6, 9, 10, present outer Step.value (UInt("7"), Bool(true), UInt("7"), Bool(true), UInt("7"), distinguishing Let statement.value ExprId 2 from outer UInt("7")), complete sequential snapshots (S0, S0, S7, S7, S7 with local total and input amount excluded from state), statement-local effect deltas ([], [], [State(count: 0->7)], [], [Emit(count, 7)]), ordered Execution.effects [State, Emit], and logical work 4+4+2+4+2 = 16 under moriarty-reference-logical-cost/1. Docs and oracle records accurately note that mori simulate observes statement root ExprIds 2, 5, 6, 9, 10 and Step contracts rather than the full 11-node Program.expressions arena.

Empty-action specimen (empty-frame.mori action idle with uninvoked declare() registering source identity for reserve/CASH/treasury/beneficiary at ExprId 0, and empty-frame.scenario.json) and expected outputs (empty.unmetered.stdout.json 2,875 bytes; empty.cap0.stdout.json 2,977 bytes) accurately specify the N=0 boundary: pre and post identically preserve declared initial state (count=UInt("5"), ready=Bool(true)), all three canonical (asset, account)-ordered CASH scale-2 balances (beneficiary="11", observer="23", treasury="97", sum="131"), and residual liability reserve="17" (debtor="treasury", creditor="beneficiary", with zero creation/accrual/discharge and no inferred pledge), steps=[], effects=[], no synthetic Step or Step.value, and logical work used="0" at cap="0".

Consumer separation for the existing normal Transfer oracle in crates/mori/tests/core_test_report.rs is explicitly preserved in CORE-EXECUTION-REPORTS.md and NR-06: the 28,093-byte golden (SHA-256 b57043f1d8fd55e80cfde729ef8e85f78225ff29129bc8da6696c7f1163e5118) belongs to the mori --color never test aggregate consumer (where Execution sits under cases[].actual.Ok and status text prints to stderr), not the 3-field or 5-field mori simulate envelope (which prints 0 stderr bytes).

Inspection of production consumer source (crates/mori/src/main.rs, commands/simulate.rs, commands/core_io.rs, crates/mori-core/src/ir.rs, json.rs, logical_cost.rs, policy.rs, parser.rs, runtime.rs) confirms that mori simulate constructs the accepted ordinary and metered envelopes via serde_json::json! (which converts Execution and nested IR structs into serde_json::Value objects backed by BTreeMap without preserve_order, yielding recursively lexical keys), formats via mori_core::json::export (2-space pretty ASCII-safe JSON under 1 MiB, depth 32, 65,536 nodes, no duplicate keys), appends one trailing LF via println! in core_io::print, writes nothing to Shell/stderr on success, and returns ExitCode::SUCCESS (0).

Target selection (-p mori --no-default-features --test core_report_contract) and crates/mori/Cargo.toml exclude the default native feature (and thus mori-backend, mori-ledger, futures, rand, and all midnight-* crates), exclude mori-core's non-default midnight-compat-tests feature, exclude all 11 native-gated integration tests, and exclude the native-gated PR191 unit tests in crates/mori/src/commands/core_io.rs (key_export_diagnostic_tests and degree_diagnostic_tests).

PROPOSAL.json specifies a single bounded ordinary command (attemptLimit=1, newAttemptSequence=1, 90s wall timeout with TERM and 5s kill grace, --frozen, -j1, --test-threads=1, nativeAuthority=0) using a fresh owned temporary root (/tmp/doctorwatson-normal-report-check-*), owned empty cwd, owned cold CARGO_TARGET_DIR, owned CARGO_HOME symlinking only public registry/git caches, a strict 13-variable environment whitelist with no HOME/keys/auth/wallet/network variables, pre-spawn SHA-256 verification of the 4 pinned binaries in TOOL-METADATA.json, and metadata-only absence recheck of all 14 ancestor Cargo config paths in CARGO-CONFIG-METADATA.json plus owned cwd/home.
